# Play Therapy Parenting

> A resource hub for parents using child-centered play therapy principles to support their children's emotional development, behavioral challenges, and relationship building.

Play Therapy Parenting provides podcast episodes and guides grounded in Child Parent Relationship Therapy (CPRT) and play therapy research, helping parents understand and address common childhood challenges through therapeutic parenting techniques. The site draws on work by leading play therapy experts including Garry Landreth, Risë VanFleet, and Susan Bratton.

## Key Topics

- play therapy
- child-centered therapy
- emotional regulation
- self-esteem and confidence building
- externalizing behaviors
- internalizing behaviors
- relational struggles
- ADHD diagnosis
- aggression in children
- therapeutic techniques
- parent-child relationship
- encouragement vs praise
- child development
- parenting guide
- CPRT (Child Parent Relationship Therapy)

## Behavioral Challenges & Emotional Issues

- [Understanding Aggression in Kids (What's Really Behind It)](https://www.playtherapyparenting.com/parent-companion-for-play-therapy-understanding-aggression-in-kids-whats-really-behind-it): Podcast episode exploring root causes of childhood aggression and therapeutic approaches
- [Externalizing Behaviors (When Big Feelings Come Out as Big Behavior)](https://www.playtherapyparenting.com/parent-companion-for-play-therapy-externalizing-behaviors-when-big-feelings-come-out-as-big-behavior): Podcast episode explaining externalizing behaviors and emotional regulation in children
- [Internalizing Behaviors (When Kids Keep It All Inside)](https://www.playtherapyparenting.com/parent-companion-for-play-therapy-internalizing-behaviors-when-kids-keep-it-all-inside): Podcast episode on recognizing and addressing internalizing behaviors in children

## Self-Esteem & Confidence Building

- [Parent Companion for Play Therapy: Helping Children Build Healthy Self-Esteem](https://www.playtherapyparenting.com/parent-companion-for-play-therapy-helping-children-build-healthy-self-esteem): Podcast episode on building healthy self-esteem in children through play therapy
- [Encouragement vs. Praise: The Key to Nurturing Self-Esteem in Your Child](https://www.playtherapyparenting.com/encouragement-vs-praise-the-key-to-nurturing-self-esteem-in-your-child): Podcast episode on using encouragement to build self-esteem and internal motivation

## Social & Relational Development

- [Relational Struggles (When Kids Have Trouble Connecting)](https://www.playtherapyparenting.com/relational-struggles-when-kids-have-trouble-connecting): Podcast episode addressing social struggles and peer relationship issues in children

## Special Topics & Diagnosis

- [ADHD Diagnosis: What Parents Need to Think Through](https://www.playtherapyparenting.com/adhd-diagnosis-what-parents-need-to-think-through): Podcast episode guiding parents through ADHD evaluation decisions using child-centered approach

## Foundational Resources & Guides

- [Play Therapy Fundamentals](https://www.playtherapyparenting.com/play-therapy-fundamentals): Compilation of foundational play therapy parenting podcasts and concepts
- [Rules of Thumb Podcasts](https://www.playtherapyparenting.com/rules-of-thumb-podcasts): Collection of CPRT-based parenting tips and therapeutic techniques podcast series
